capabilities.description: Maintain detailed records for animal patients and their owners, including demographics, medical history, owner contact details, and relationships between pets and clients.
Schedule, reschedule, and manage appointments for veterinary services, with reminders, calendar views, and resource allocation for rooms and staff.
Capture and store visit notes, diagnoses, treatment plans, and prescriptions, including medication details, dosages, and administration instructions.
Track vaccination history for each animal, including vaccine type, date administered, next due date, and reminders for upcoming vaccinations.
Generate invoices for services, treatments, and products, track payments, manage billing cycles, and integrate with accounting systems.
Provide dashboards and reports on practice performance, patient outcomes, appointment trends, and financial metrics to support decision-making.
Ensure all clinical and financial records are immutable and auditable, meeting veterinary regulatory requirements and data privacy standards.
Send automated reminders for appointments, vaccinations, and follow-ups via email or SMS, and manage client communications.

summary: A comprehensive practice management platform for veterinary clinics, enabling staff to maintain animal patient records, client/owner profiles, appointment scheduling, clinical visit notes, treatments and prescriptions, vaccination tracking, and billing/invoicing. It serves veterinarians, vet technicians, front-desk staff, and clinic administrators, centralizing all operational, clinical, and financial workflows to improve care quality and practice efficiency.
